2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

The ÄKTA Pure chromatography run was executed using an automated workflow consisting of a manual preparation step followed by execution of the predefined ÄKTA protocol.

3.1 Manual Preparation
  • The system was paused with the instruction: "Manually fill sample loop" prior to starting the automated ÄKTA run.
  • Sample was loaded into the ÄKTA sample loop according to the experimental plan.
3.2 ÄKTA Run Parameters

The following run parameters were configured for this chromatography process (where applicable to the selected method phases):

Parameter Value Unit / Notes
Equilibration duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Time for column equilibration at flow rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]].
Equilibration flow rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during column equilibration.
Load/inject duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Time for loading sample via injection.
Load/inject flow rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during sample loading.
Elution gradient duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total gradient time.
Elution gradient start [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting modifier concentration (e.g. %B).
Elution gradient end [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final modifier concentration (e.g. %B).
Wash duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Post-run wash time at flow rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]].
Wash flow rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during wash phase.
CIP (clean-in-place) duration [[CIP_DURATION]] Main CIP phase.
CIP step 3 duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Additional CIP phase 3 duration.
CIP step 4 duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Additional CIP phase 4 duration.
CIP step 5 duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Additional CIP phase 5 duration.
CIP step 2 hold duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during CIP step 2.

During the run, the ÄKTA Pure system recorded UV and conductivity signals over time, as defined in the protocol (e.g. UV channel: uv1, conductivity channel: cond).
